name: agent-memory-advisor
description: Agent memory stack advisor: diagnoses broken memory loops and recommends which open-source memory projects (Mem0, Graphiti, Cognee, Letta, etc.) to adopt by scenario.

displayDescription.en: Diagnoses broken agent-memory loops and picks a landing stack from 10 open-source projects by scenario (coding, personal agent, company brain).
displayDescription.zh: 按写代码/个人智能体/公司大脑三类场景，从 10 个开源记忆项目挑出能落地的一套，并诊断记忆断环。

defaultInitPrompt.zh: 我要给自己的 AI 智能体加记忆，帮我按场景选一套开源方案
defaultInitPrompt.en: I want to add memory to my AI agent — help me pick an open-source stack by scenario
